substantive_delta: A deterministic full-model uncolored 2D Range-LIS reporting algorithm with O((n+m)n^(2/3)log^30(n+m+2))+O(K) operations. The specialized new algorithmic step computes canonical-path traces against all original vertices of disjoint parent index intervals and charges O(|I|k log^2 n+k^3 polylog n) at each merge. Equal-original-size relative merging gives a long-path hitting set of O(n^(1/3)log^3 n) points in O(n^(5/3)polylog n) time, which integrates with the established short/stitching routines.
why_nonroutine: A path on the selected vertices alone need not equal the selected trace of the actual original canonical path. Existing generic sampling statements supply neither that original-background oracle nor its charged cost. The proof constructs source trees on full original intervals, compresses them exactly, evaluates the conditional scores with bounded-word arithmetic, and sums background work using interval disjointness. These steps close a genuine implicit-input interface gap rather than assuming a free subset oracle. Generic sample rates, conditional expectation and descendant sums are prior art and are not separately credited as innovations.
significance: The algorithm gives a fixed polynomial saving over quadratic overhead for every input of the precise 2D reporting model, answering the deterministic existence question explicitly posed in the current Range-LIS source. It covers arbitrary real ties, all optimum lengths and overlaps with additive output time. This is a substantive specialized algorithmic resolution despite being slower than the randomized benchmark; STOC-level breadth and technical depth are assessed conservatively and separately.
